lines: To hunger gathered home, to hankering overlong —
to the moon-wreathed Master, Patron: hail.
sanskrit_cite: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ

lines: 'Feckless, what feat can I?' — to him who plots no path at all,
all-helping Force of the Benign: my hold.
sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

lines: Past quality, whose self is sheer eminence averred,
Bhava, in what nook lurks thy peer?
sanskrit_cite: guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava

lines: In the twinless, the traceless, in thee, the Self abiding, Lord,
we yet are gulled by thy bottomless beguilement.
sanskrit_cite: nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava

lines: Fineness from the first, overlordship ever, birth's close,
these, Bhava, are love-tree shoots from thee.
sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ

lines: No airt un-tenanted by thee — all hours thy tissue,
gotten already, yet when got, Lord? Utter.
sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām

lines: Hail who haunts sole the honest pellucid hearts —
ash-white of limb, high Gander, Śambhu.
Plucked the rank murk, burnt each birth-faggot whole:
be my ken-lamp, Lord, my love-lamp.
sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā

lines: Framed the triple stage, seed-pregnant with the true,
Hara, to unframe: what bard but thou suffices?
sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ

lines: Hail to unmake the is and is-not to nought or aught,
to tied and untied, the wastrel-sovereign in one.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline
